text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — planning a coordinated launch + marketplace listing for the LangChain connector, ACME Gateway adapter, and our HW partner validation. Need owners & timeline. Proposed announce window: Oct 14-20. Who can own the marketplace listing and the Dedicated/Private validation run?

Mira Patel: I can own co-announce copy + partner comms. Can we target Oct 18? Need final assets by Oct 6. @Samir can you confirm integration test windows?

Samir Khan: Working on the gateway adapter. Two items: 1) compatibility matrix for kernels/quantization; 2) end-to-end smoke test on Dedicated. Free for testing Oct 2-5. I can take listing integration if needed.

Jordan Lee: I'll coordinate HW validation with our infra partners. Need sample perf numbers and a test harness. Can someone drop a minimal config we can run on the partner kit?

Alex Chen: Nice. Minimal config to run in lab:
```yaml
adapter:
  name: redwood-acme-adapter
  runtime: dedicated
  model: llama-3-70b-q4
  quant: int8
tests:
  - smoke
  - inference_latency_95p
```

Priya Gupta: Marketplace contact (Sonia at GCP marketplace) asked for security checklist + listing HTML by Oct 9. I can draft the security blurb. @Mira pls loop Sonia into the asset review.

Samir Khan: :thumbsup: I'll drop the compatibility matrix by EOD Sep 28. Also adding a tiny LangChain adapter snippet for the README:
```py
from redwood import GatewayAdapter
adapter = GatewayAdapter("acme://redwood")
```

Mira Patel: I'll add Sonia to the review thread. Also need marketing hero image + 1-min demo. @Jordan can the HW lab record a quick demo on Oct 3?

Jordan Lee: Yes, we can record. We'll need a stable checkpoint and a short prompt set. Samir — can you draft a 3-minute demo script?

Samir Khan: On it. Draft script by Sep 30. Small ask — can eng-runtime run a perf pass with the same input set (seq len 512) so we have comparable cost numbers?

Alex Chen: Action items: Samir = adapter + demo script + compat matrix; Mira = co-announce copy + assets + partner comms; Jordan = HW lab demo + perf harness; Priya = marketplace ops + security. I'll own announcement timing and press list. Sync Thu 10am PT — calendar invite incoming.
